title: Sources: Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and others in a 21-bank consortium have committed ~$270M to fund five years of a stablecoin venture announced in September (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and others in a 21-bank consortium have committed ~$270M to fund five years of a stablecoin venture announced in September — A group of financial firms including Goldman Sachs Group Inc., Citigroup Inc., Banco Santander SA and Deutsche Bank AG …
